meta.name: Lead Light
meta.notes: Primary and accent are clamped to glass lightness and mixed with amber, rose and sea-green to glaze a canvas Voronoi stained-glass window and rose nav; primary also fills CTAs, active filters and illuminated initials on pale limestone.

issues: Product panes in the window had tiny Voronoi cores, so each photo was a peephole squeezed behind its plaque and cramped against the sill
Plaques were pulled up 70% of their height, so on mobile they overlapped the 'Our rooms' band heading
The large clear hero pane read as flat beige paper instead of glass, which broke the stained-glass illusion where it mattered most
Categories used an auto-fit grid: 6 items wrapped as 5 + 1 orphan on the left, and on mobile became one very tall single column
Mobile virtues were four full-width arches, a long run of empty stone
Big dead gap between the category chapels and the story section
Catalog grid left-aligned 3 items and left an empty fourth column
fixed: Product seeds are now about 3x larger (25–32% of the pane on each axis, base weight 10), so photos read as glazed pictures and the spring swell has something to push
Plaques straddle the lower edge of the pane core (translate -50%) and are capped inside the pane, so they no longer collide with the band on mobile
Clear panes are quarry-glazed: a faint diamond came lattice drawn on the canvas, clipped to each clear cell
Categories are a centred flex row of chapels with staggered heights on desktop and two per row on phones; tightened the spacing after them
Mobile virtues pair up two by two with smaller roundels, which roughly halves the scroll length
Catalog lancets are centred, capped-width tracks
